_README: Hand-maintained next-steps, merged into the page by render.py. Everything
else on that page comes from the ASC/Play/iTunes APIs; this file is the part
only a person (or a session) knows. Keys must match the app `name` in
`stage` orders the What's next list. `do` is kaolin's own next action -
phrase it as the thing HE does, not what a session is doing. Omit `do`
entirely when the honest answer is 'nothing, it's out of your hands'.
Note the framing kaolin corrected on 2026-08-13: an update in flight is a
submission-in-progress, not a finished app. render.py derives that from
TestFlight-vs-live versions, so it stays true without editing this file.

_STAGES.5: Blocked on something that isn't code

Cosmic Specks.why: 6.4 days is ~3x your other two, it was expedited, and the eclipse window it was timed for has passed — so the reason for the rush is gone either way. Leave it, or withdraw and resubmit with a listing that doesn't lean on the eclipse.

Sandpainting: Zen Sand Art.why: Its session signed off with 'nothing left on your side' — submission complete, including the IAP item that had to be finished in the browser.

Magic Messages.why: Build 18 in review. Build 19 is on Grayhame as a dev build, which doesn't affect the review — that phone is off the TestFlight track until you ask for it back.

Spot The Hustle.do: Play Console → Add credential → pick 'Play app signing key' → Save.
Spot The Hustle.why: One click unblocks build 37 to the Moto and the first real leaderboard test. Confirmed from the API: the package has only alpha and internal tracks, so Google production access has NOT come through. Also pending: your 18 closed testers aren't on the OAuth test-user list, so leaderboards silently no-op for them.

FractRoam.do: Answered — going to the beta track so you can check it on your phone.
FractRoam.why: R8 + SDK bump: 68% smaller download (AAB 483 KB), clears three of four Play advisories, verified on device including the shrink-fragile Share FileProvider path. Live is still versionCode 3.

thereby.do: Say what 'visual design polish' means — then it needs an ASC record, screenshots, and a first TestFlight build.
thereby.why: The code is genuinely last-mile: build 78 on Grayhame, 134 core tests, 9/9 flows. But there's no App Store Connect record yet, so all the store-side work is still ahead. Watch work (ask-every-time trip start) is in flight now.

BabyPaints.why: The session has moved past painting polish into measurement — the two-thirds power law now checks out against your actual recorded input (v ∝ r^0.35 vs theory's 0.33, n=218) rather than being inferred from pixels. 1,192 tests green. It's also Godot with an Android preset already, so Play is closer than you'd think.

Hide and See.do: Confirm free-with-no-IAP is final, then it needs an ASC record + screenshots.
Hide and See.why: Dropping the $2.99 unlock takes the paywall off the critical path. Build 22 on Grayhame; the session is deep in fusion-teaching experiments (Pair/Tint/Fine), which is product work rather than store work.

Spinnit.do: Try free spin on a real phone — it's never been tested on a body.
Spinnit.why: Everything verified so far is replay. Two things to feel for: whether 1.2 s to land is right (a guess, unlike train's 3 s which came from data), and whether the planet name flickers when you sit between two — worst around Mars↔Earth.

sevensez.do: Decide if it's a product or a personal tool.
sevensez.why: On Grayhame with a real icon and signing set up. Before investing in store work: 7-of-9 frame agreement, 33.9% exact, 7.1% wrong on held-out real meters — it refuses a lot on purpose.

Naming Rattle.do: Resolve the art and font situation. Nothing else can move.
Naming Rattle.why: A ghosting artist, legacy Joyce Croft interior art, and possibly unlicensed lettering. Until that's settled there is nothing legally shippable to upload. Its TestFlight build is 53 days old.

Curiouser: Presence & Wonder.do: Pick one: mint promo codes, or add a cross-promo line to Timeful/FractRoam release notes.
Curiouser: Presence & Wonder.why: 1.4 is in TestFlight ahead of 1.3 live. The growth lever you already own is ~820 update-events across Timeful and FractRoam in two weeks — one release-note line reaches more relevant people than any single Reddit post.

Saintify.why: 2.0.0 in TestFlight ahead of 1.1.0 live, with 2 testers actually installed (Craig and Anna). Fiel is the only genuinely unaccepted invite.

Disasteroids.why: 1.2.0/143 in TestFlight ahead of 1.1.0 live. Godot with an iOS-only preset — Android is genuinely greenfield, verified across all branches, not half-finished.

izzit.why: 1.1.1 live on both stores; Play production 1.1.210.
